m7_trade_level_accounting.interpretation: these are INDEPENDENT per-trade returns compounded as if a single all-in, fully-reinvested, sequential position — NOT executable portfolio equity; the entries overlap in time (see concurrency)

capital_constrained_portfolio_accounting.note: capital-constrained portfolio replay on genuine bars; executable-equity drawdown (time-indexed), not compounded per-trade; simulated, not live

sharpe_annualization_note: M7 reported a PER-TRADE Sharpe (periods_per_year=None), not annualized; the portfolio replay reports a properly annualized Sharpe from periodic equity returns. Both remain negative for the incumbent.

drawdown_finding.conclusion: The M7 ~90%+ drawdown is a COMPOUNDED INDEPENDENT TRADE-LEVEL artifact (all-in sequential single-position reinvestment), not executable portfolio equity. Under a capital-constrained portfolio (10% per position, max 10 concurrent), the time-indexed equity drawdown is 80.3%. The strategy's per-trade economics are still negative, so the corrected accounting does NOT rescue the strategy — it only corrects the magnitude/interpretation of the drawdown and the Sharpe basis.
drawdown_finding.genuine_accounting_defect: Scoring overlapping entries as a single sequential all-in compounded series misrepresents executable drawdown and capital at risk; the portfolio accountant (cengine/alpha/portfolio_replay.py) is the corrected model.

note: ACCOUNTING correction only — the per-trade economics (negative expectancy, PF<1) are preserved and unchanged; the correction is to the drawdown interpretation and Sharpe annualization basis. Historical-replay, not live.
